title: arum maculatum subsp. angustatum
intro: Arum maculatum subsp. angustatum, commonly known as the Narrow-leaved Lords and Ladies, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Arum family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Arum maculatum subsp. angustatum include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its use as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
